headline: How Canadian Choice Fixed a Campaign Email That Broke in Outlook
seoTitle: Canadian Choice Case Study: Outlook Email Fix | MailStora
summary: Canadian Choice's seasonal campaign template was breaking in Outlook. MailStora rebuilt it from scratch in 36 hours, and the campaign reached a 38% open rate with every Outlook version rendering correctly.
challenge:
Canadian Choice Windows & Doors was preparing a seasonal Mailchimp campaign, but its existing email template broke in Outlook. Layouts shifted, sections collapsed and the design no longer matched the brand, which put the campaign at risk.
Patching the old template was not an option: every fix for Outlook risked breaking Gmail or mobile.
solution: MailStora rebuilt the template from scratch with hand-coded, table-based HTML and inline CSS, the approach that renders reliably in every Outlook version. The layout was built mobile-first so it adapts cleanly from phones to desktop, and it was set up for editing in Mailchimp.
approach:
Reviewed the broken template and the campaign design
Rebuilt the layout in table-based HTML with inline CSS
Made the design mobile-first and fully responsive
Tested in Gmail, Outlook 365, Apple Mail and iOS Mail
Delivered the Mailchimp-ready template in 36 hours
results:
38% | Open rate
2.4x | Click rate
100% | Outlook versions rendering correctly
36 hours | From brief to delivery

seoTitle: Urban Vogue Case Study: $6.3k Klaviyo Promo | MailStora
summary: Urban Vogue needed a seasonal promo email that sold on mobile. MailStora built a dynamic Klaviyo product grid with dark mode support, and the campaign generated $6.3k in revenue with a 28% open rate.
challenge:
Urban Vogue, a fashion retailer, wanted a seasonal promotion that showcased many products without becoming slow or cluttered on phones, where most of its customers read email.
The design also had to hold up in older email clients and in dark mode.
solution: MailStora built a mobile-first product grid in Klaviyo with dynamic product blocks, so products could be updated without touching code. The layout degrades gracefully in older email clients, and colours and logos were set up for dark mode.

Planned a product grid that works on small screens first
Coded the template in custom HTML for Klaviyo
Added dynamic product blocks for easy updates
Added dark mode support
Tested in iOS Mail, Gmail and Apple Mail
